description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.13, §3.19: a brazier or bonfire at every troll site): an iron fire-bowl on a stone pedestal. Tagged fire: smashed, its coals set every troll within its regeneration's brazier_radius_m Burning (P34's rule, EnemyActor: no regeneration while it burns) and set alight a brood nest within reach (BroodNest).
